abouthero.title: Hey! I am Chris
abouthero.description: I'm a senior product designer who also builds. For 10+ years I've designed software for industries where work happens on site: paper mills, energy, construction. Today I take products from the first interview with a site manager to the code running in production.
list: 6 ERP/MES apps for the paper industry

items.title: Voltiq: construction management
items.description: Co-founder and product lead. I designed and built the whole system: an office panel and a mobile app for site crews, connecting the tender cost estimate, subcontractor quotes, contracts, tasks pinned to PDF drawings and progress reports.
points: Runs a live contract in Krakow: 198 tasks, a 360-item cost estimate imported straight from the client's Excel file, 7 crew members on mobile.
Subcontractors quote through a plain link, with no account or password, because every required login kills adoption on site.
The crew uploaded 1,565 site photos in a single day without a single failure.

items.title: Comgy: smart metering software
items.description: I took on the responsibility of designing two web platforms and one mobile application.
points: MGM: A platform tailored to real estate companies utilizing an app for their portfolios. The platform aimed to automate reporting, leverage decarbonization potential, meet regulatory obligations and promote energy-saving initiatives.
Tenant Portal: An interactive tenant portal enabling users to monitor their consumption and identify potential areas for energy savings.
MIM: A mobile application designed for installers who have install devices in real estates.

items.title: Paper industry: ERP & MES
items.description: I designed six integrated web applications (ERP, MES) for the paper industry, each covering a different part of the business: logistics, production, measurement, packaging, HR and ordering.

items.title: Taxonomy management software
items.description: I was responsible for the design of a web application for businesses that deal with large volumes of data.

items.title: Aquathon 2021
items.description: A portal for local activists to assess the advantages of implementing retention measures in the city.

items.title: HackYeah 2020
items.description: An agricultural farm portal that enables the calculation of afforestation benefits.

items.title: CodePlay 2019
items.description: An AI-powered application that utilizes Machine Learning to track users and notify them about nearby store discounts.

items.title: HackYeah 2018
items.description: A web application designed to compute the most efficient route for heavy transport.

description: I share what I learn while building. I speak at design conferences such as WaysConf and DesignWays, mentor designers, and have won hackathons (HackYeah, Aquathon, CodePlay).
On stage I talk about the same things I do every day: making complex products simple enough that people on site actually use them.

work.title: How I make projects
work.description: From the first conversation on site to a product people use every day.

steps.title: Discover
steps.contentTitle: Understanding the problem and user needs
steps.content: I explore the problem space, exploring through research and interviews to grasp client needs, understand the audience, and uncover challenges that will shape our design journey.

steps.title: Define
steps.content: Together with stakeholders, we create a clear document that summarizes our vision. We set specific goals, identify our target audience, and establish design principles to guide our creative process.

steps.title: Develop
steps.content: Bringing our ideas to life, I love working together in design sessions. We use sketches, prototypes, and make improvements to create solutions that combine functionality, beauty, and an amazing user experience.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.content: I don't stop at handoff. I build or co-build the product, ship it to real users, and keep improving it based on how it is used on site.

skillset.title: Skillset
skillset.description: I am continually seeking new opportunities to learn, grow, and refine my craft, aiming to push the boundaries of my creative potential.

skills.title: User-centered Design
skills.description: UCD is my design philosophy, prioritizing user needs and behaviors. It guides me to create not just visually appealing but also highly functional and intuitive designs through in-depth user research.

skills.title: Prototyping and Wireframing
skills.description: Prototyping and wireframing are my creative playgrounds, where I transform ideas into tangible, interactive representations, allowing quick experimentation, iteration, and user validation.

skills.title: Design & Code
skills.description: I build what I design: Next.js, React, databases and AI tooling. This lets me test ideas on real data, ship faster and talk to developers in their language.

skills.title: Design Research
skills.description: Design research is my tool to understand user behavior and needs, helping me uncover pain points and opportunities through methods like interviews, surveys, and usability studies.

skills.title: Domain Knowledge
skills.description: Construction, manufacturing, energy. I learn the domain from the people doing the work, so the product follows how the job really gets done, not how it looks in a spec.

skills.title: Cross-Functional Collaboration
skills.description: In cross-functional teams, I act as a bridge, translating the design vision to resonate with product managers, developers, and marketers, fostering open communication and understanding.

skills.title: Strategic Thinking
skills.description: I bring a strategic perspective to design, aligning it with our business goals by translating objectives into actionable design strategies.

skills.title: Design System Knowledge
skills.description: I value design systems for their efficiency, scalability, and ability to ensure a coherent user experience. They are the blueprint for a harmonious design journey.
